referencePolicy.sourcePriority: Current official PhiladelphiaEagles.com player roster/headshot page
referencePolicy.visualRule: Artists/generators must inspect the cited current official headshot before rendering. Never infer skin tone, hair, facial hair, facial features, or other visible appearance from a player's name, biography, position, or stale asset.
referencePolicy.style: realistic 3D chibi; adult football proportions; recognizable at Gamecast scale

render.camera: three-quarter front; match approved Dallas production camera
render.lighting: soft stadium key plus cool rim; match approved Dallas production lighting
render.numberAccuracy: required; re-check official roster before final render

verification.appearanceSafety: A reference lock establishes the current official team headshot as source of truth. No skin tone, hair, facial-hair or facial-feature value is guessed or encoded from a name, nickname, biography, heritage, or position.
verification.signatureSafety: No named player-specific celebration is asserted by this batch. Signature research remains a later phase and requires a verifiable source.
